about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Camp Gear Set Vol. 3

A set of the Handlers' favorite camp gears that can be used within the camp options.

Give your camp a fresh makeover with special camp gear!

*You can use camp gear sets by speaking to the Pop-up Camp Meowster or Pop-up Camp Purrofessional and selecting Camp Gear Options from the Edit Pop-up Camps menu.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
